lines.en: I crossed the street to avoid meeting him, but he saw me and came running towards me.
lines.zh: 我穿过马路以便避开他，但他看到我并朝我跑过来。

lines.en: It was no use pretending that I had not seen him, so I waved to him.
lines.zh: 若再装作没看见他已是没有用了，我只好向他招手。

lines.en: I never enjoy meeting Nigel Dykes .
He never has anything to do.
No matter how busy you are, he always insists on coming with you.
lines.zh: 他从来都是无事可做，不管你多忙，他总是坚持要跟你去。

lines.en: I had to think of a way of preventing him from following me around all morning.
lines.zh: 我得想办法不让他整个上午缠着我。
“你好，奈杰尔，想不到在这儿见到你。
“你好，伊丽莎白，”奈杰尔回答说，“我正不知道怎么消磨这一上午呢，正好见到你。

lines.en: 'I was just wondering how to spend the morning -- until I saw you.
You're not busy doing anything, are you?
'Would you mind my coming with you?
he asked, before I had finished speaking.
lines.zh: “没关系，但我准备去牙医那里。

lines.en: 'Not at all,' I lied, 'but I'm going to the dentist.
'Then I'll come with you,' he answered.
lines.zh: “那我也跟你去，候诊室里总有很多东西可供阅读！

lines.en: 'There's always plenty to read in the waiting room!

question.en: Why did Elizabeth tell Nigel that she was going to the dentist?
